Theorem
[Characterization of Constant-Curvature Metrics]

1. ch1:1.9

The complete connected $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifolds of constant sectional curvature are, up to isometry, exactly the quotients $\widetilde M/\Gamma $, where $\widetilde M$ is Euclidean, spherical, or hyperbolic space with constant sectional curvature and $\Gamma $ is a discrete group of isometries acting freely on $\widetilde M$.
